itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The printed schedule pages (p3 Schedule A, p7 Schedule B) are empty apart from 'See Attached List' and carry NO subtotal or total, so no gate exists on them. The attachments print no 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' per page either - only ONE grand total per schedule, at the end of the last attachment page. Both grand-total gates FIRE exactly: Schedule A rows across p4+p5+p6 sum 53100.00 = printed $53,100.00; Schedule B rows on p8 sum 20549.59 = printed $20,549.59. Because there is no per-page subtotal on the contributions attachment, the p4/p5/p6 split figures above are MY page sums, not printed ones - they are stated as such and were not used to adjudicate anything. The Summary Page balance chain also closes: 38186.50 + 53100.00 = 91286.50; 91286.50 - 20549.59 = 70736.91.

itemized.notes: 8-page AMENDMENT. Cover: YEAR-END January 31 box checked AND 'Is this report an amendment? Yes' ticked with date of report '1-31-07'; the signature line is dated '2/14/07 as amended' and the clerk stamp reads FEB 14 2007 - so the form is an amendment of the 1/31/07 year-end report, filed 2/14/07. Page order: p1 cover, p2 Summary Page, p3 printed Schedule A ('See Attached List'), p4-p6 the CONTRIBUTIONS attachment (typed, 83 rows, headed 'PAGE 4 OF 8 / CORROON / DATE OF REPORT 1/31/07' and continuing), p7 printed Schedule B ('See Attached List'), p8 the EXPENDITURES attachment (typed, 33 rows, headed 'PAGE 8 OF 8'). The three contribution attachment pages are stored ROTATED inside the PDF; every geometry pointer below is converted back to the portrait page as poppler renders it, so each contribution row's band is a VERTICAL strip. SOURCE PROPERTY - the DATE column on the contributions attachment is almost entirely EMPTY: only 5 of 83 rows carry a date (6/21/2006, 7/7/2006, 8/1/2006 and 8/24/2006 twice). Each date is recorded ONLY on the row it is printed on; it was NOT carried down to following rows, because nothing on the form says it applies to them. SOURCE PROPERTY - the ADDRESS column on the contributions attachment is empty for 82 of 83 rows; the single exception (Nancy Melich) prints a street address, which was discarded at read time with only city/state retained (privacy). Schedule B row 11 is dated 3/29/2007 - after the report date and outside the 2006 period - and is kept verbatim, flagged. Source typos kept verbatim and named per row: 'Sinclair Oli', 'Sculpton', 'Matheson for Govenor', 'Snow Christiensen & Martineau'.
